machine.DESC:
Generic Mac with GNU compilers, with libraries (MPI, NetCDF, etc.) from a package manager such as Homebrew or MacPorts. Use it by adding `--machine macos` to create_newcase or create_test.
The MPI library defaults to openmpi if ompi_info is in your PATH, otherwise mpich; use `--mpilib` to choose a different one.
System-specific customizations can be provided via environment variables, as described below. Of these, the most critical is ESMFMKFILE, which is needed to build CESM; the others are needed only in certain cases.
Defaults can be overridden with these environment variables:
CIME_MACOS_ROOTDIR: Parent of the scratch (CIME_OUTPUT_ROOT), cesm-inputdata (DIN_LOC_ROOT) and cesm-baselines (BASELINE_ROOT) directories. Default: $HOME/projects
CIME_MACOS_NUM_CORES: Cores available for running (MAX_TASKS_PER_NODE, MAX_MPITASKS_PER_NODE). Default: number of performance cores
CIME_MACOS_CPRNC: Path to a pre-built cprnc executable. Default: cprnc is built when a test needs it
The following variables FOO are set in the case's environment from CIME_MACOS_[COMPILER]_[MPILIB]_FOO if set (e.g., CIME_MACOS_GNU_OPENMPI_PIO, CIME_MACOS_GNU_MPISERIAL_PIO), else from FOO; if neither is set, FOO is left unset:
ESMFMKFILE: Path to esmf.mk of an ESMF built with this compiler and MPI library; needed to build CESM
PIO, PIO_VERSION_MAJOR, PIO_TYPENAME_VALID_VALUES: Pre-built PIO install directory, its major version (e.g., 2) and the I/O types it supports (e.g., netcdf or netcdf,netcdf4c). Set all or none. Default: PIO is built with the model
NETCDF_PATH: NetCDF install directory, if in a non-standard location. Default: the package manager prefix (/opt/homebrew, /opt/local or /usr/local)
PFUNIT_PATH: pFUnit install directory; needed for Fortran unit tests
MPISERIAL: Pre-built mpi-serial library; needed by some unit test builds
All of these variables are read whenever CIME loads a case's settings, not just at case creation, so keep them consistent for the life of a case.
Example (e.g., in ~/.bashrc), supporting openmpi for model runs and mpi-serial for unit tests; note that each MPI library needs its own ESMF and PIO builds. Setting CIME_MACHINE makes the `--machine` argument unnecessary:
export CIME_MODEL=cesm export CIME_MACHINE=macos export CIME_MACOS_CPRNC=$HOME/cprnc_builds/cprnc_v1.1.0-4-gf4979ab export CIME_MACOS_GNU_OPENMPI_ESMFMKFILE=$HOME/esmf_builds/esmfv8.8.0_openmpi/install_dir/lib/libg/Darwin.gfortranclang.64.openmpi.default/esmf.mk export CIME_MACOS_GNU_OPENMPI_PIO=$HOME/pio_builds/pio2_6_5 export CIME_MACOS_GNU_OPENMPI_PIO_VERSION_MAJOR=2 export CIME_MACOS_GNU_OPENMPI_PIO_TYPENAME_VALID_VALUES=netcdf export CIME_MACOS_GNU_MPISERIAL_ESMFMKFILE=$HOME/esmf_builds/esmfv8.8.0_mpiuni/install_dir/lib/libg/Darwin.gfortranclang.64.mpiuni.default/esmf.mk export CIME_MACOS_GNU_MPISERIAL_PIO=$HOME/pio_builds/pio2_6_5_mpiserial export CIME_MACOS_GNU_MPISERIAL_PIO_VERSION_MAJOR=2 export CIME_MACOS_GNU_MPISERIAL_PIO_TYPENAME_VALID_VALUES=netcdf export CIME_MACOS_GNU_MPISERIAL_PFUNIT_PATH=$HOME/pfunit_builds/pfunit4.11.1-gfortran14.2.0/install export CIME_MACOS_GNU_MPISERIAL_MPISERIAL=$HOME/mpi-serial_builds/MPIserial_2.5.2
machine.MPILIBS: $SHELL{if command -v ompi_info >/dev/null; then echo openmpi,mpich; else echo mpich,openmpi; fi}

environment_variables.env: $SHELL{printenv CIME_MACOS_$(echo $COMPILER_$MPILIB | tr a-z A-Z | tr -d -)_ESMFMKFILE || printenv ESMFMKFILE || true}
$SHELL{printenv CIME_MACOS_$(echo $COMPILER_$MPILIB | tr a-z A-Z | tr -d -)_PIO || printenv PIO || true}
$SHELL{printenv CIME_MACOS_$(echo $COMPILER_$MPILIB | tr a-z A-Z | tr -d -)_PIO_VERSION_MAJOR || printenv PIO_VERSION_MAJOR || true}
$SHELL{printenv CIME_MACOS_$(echo $COMPILER_$MPILIB | tr a-z A-Z | tr -d -)_PIO_TYPENAME_VALID_VALUES || printenv PIO_TYPENAME_VALID_VALUES || true}
$SHELL{printenv CIME_MACOS_$(echo $COMPILER_$MPILIB | tr a-z A-Z | tr -d -)_NETCDF_PATH || printenv NETCDF_PATH || true}
$SHELL{printenv CIME_MACOS_$(echo $COMPILER_$MPILIB | tr a-z A-Z | tr -d -)_PFUNIT_PATH || printenv PFUNIT_PATH || true}
$SHELL{printenv CIME_MACOS_$(echo $COMPILER_$MPILIB | tr a-z A-Z | tr -d -)_MPISERIAL || printenv MPISERIAL || true}
